title: Misrepresentation
claim_summary: The cardholder asserts the merchant substantially misrepresented what was sold — the product or service description was vague, inaccurate, or insufficient — and they were misled about the nature or terms of the purchase.

requirements.description: Evidence the sales terms and description presented at purchase were accurate and not misleading, and that the merchant delivered what was represented.
Proof the complaint is about product quality rather than misrepresentation of the terms or nature of what was sold (the distinction between 13.5 and 13.3).
If a refund was already issued, documentation showing the cardholder's account was credited.
If resolved directly with the cardholder, written correspondence showing they no longer wish to dispute the charge.

meta.note: Focuses on substantial misrepresentation of what was sold, not mere quality (which is 13.3). Supersedes the merchant's refund policy. Summarized from a reputable secondary source aligned with Visa merchant dispute guidelines; cross-check against current Visa Core Rules or your acquirer before production use.
